_comment: Safety layer for scoring. Default block rating comes from the neighborhood (build.ts); the overrides below are per-building hand checks from online reviews, researched 2026-08-24. reviews: good | concerns | bad. flag: ok | mixed | rough-block. A status here overrides the row status.

inv-european-hostel.note: Reviews call it shelter-like with cleanliness and safety complaints; street watch till 7pm, guests told not to go out after. Cheap for a reason, verify in person before sending anyone.

pl-hive-coliving-was-tribe.note: Strong community reviews, multi-year residents. Folsom St block is standard SoMa.

inv-upmarket-residences.note: Residents praise the building; 7th St block is standard SoMa, fine by day.

inv-found-study-16-turk-st.note: Building itself is secure (overnight security, on-site management) and residents call it safe and quiet inside; the Turk and Taylor block outside is one of the roughest in the city.

pl-found-study-sf-built-for-exactly-this.note: Secure building, rough block at Turk and Taylor.

inv-sweden-house.note: Guests say clean and safe inside considering the Tenderloin; unmarked entrance, homeless activity on the block.

pl-boston-hotel-sro.note: Reviews call the hotel itself clean and secure; 140 Turk is core Tenderloin.

inv-the-mission-hotel-apartments.note: Not a market rental: 237 units of permanent supportive housing for formerly homeless adults, run by Tenderloin Housing Clinic since 1999. Ruled out.

inv-hi-san-francisco-downtown.note: Consistently strong reviews; Mason St sits between Union Square and the Tenderloin edge.

inv-amsterdam-hostel.note: Well reviewed; Taylor St is the calmer upper edge of the Tenderloin.

inv-harcourt-hotel-residence.note: Larkin at Sutter, Tenderloin edge; long-stay residence hotel, check a room in person.

pl-crystal-hotel-residential-master-leas.note: Report already flags 24th and Mission street conditions as rough but improving under the 2026 police surge.

pl-mosser-sro-1000-market-st-owner-stuck.note: Market at 6th is the roughest stretch of Market St.

inv-the-mosser-hotel.note: Tourist hotel at 4th and Market, standard downtown block.

pl-brownstone-shared-housing.note: 1049 Market sits on the 6th to 7th St stretch; pod sleeping, tour before committing.

inv-panoramic-residences.note: Modern secure tower with good resident reviews; 9th and Mission corner outside is rough.

inv-the-6th-collective-coliving.note: Howard at 6th; the 6th St corridor is the hardest block in SoMa.

pl-mason-at-hive-auction-july-28-12-days.note: Oakland auction property, no review base.
